class.name: OsgTiledMeshOptions
class.description: Options used by the [code]osg[/code] tiled mesh adapter. The adapter recognizes [code].osg[/code] and [code].osgb[/code], preserves PagedLOD and ProxyNode replacement groups, and serializes all OSG parsing through one worker.

constants.constant: Maps OSG [code](X, Y, Z)[/code] to Godot [code](X, Z, -Y)[/code].
